exposure: Prenatal telbivudine (LdT) exposure during the third trimester
outcome: Infant neurological development (gross motor, fine motor, adaptive, linguistic, personal social domains)
cohort: Infants born from mothers treated with telbivudine (LdT) in the third trimester for prevention of hepatitis B virus (HBV) mother-to-infant transmission, compared to infants whose mothers were untreated.
finding: Prenatal LdT exposure was independently associated with higher gross motor development scores and rates of normal development, but lower rates of normal adaptive development at 36 months.
